operations.title: Benincasa reports the soft-Tate to e6 typing gate
operations.body: Entry 1126 prevents a premature identification. Hom_C3(Q[C3],<e6>) is one-dimensional, so symmetry forces only the shape c*(1,1,1). Deck characters are compatible, but the frozen maps stop at (i) soft Gysin -> tau_i and (ii) g111_top -> e6/(8(X1+X2)); no source morphism connects tau_i or their augmentation to g111_top/e6. Thus c, including c=0 vs nonzero, is undetermined. The next legitimate calculation is the complete source-normalized rank-12 specialization at (u,v)=(2,0), retaining the nodal Tate and e6 coordinates in one complex before cyclic quotienting.
